# unifi_vpn_servers (Data Source)

Lists the VPN servers of a site via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication. The `id` is the Official API UUID (used e.g. as a member of the Vpn firewall zone); for a server managed as `unifi_network`, the same value is its `official_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires a controller running 10.1.78+ with API-key authentication (Official API).
data "unifi_vpn_servers" "wireguard" {
  filter = "type.eq('WIREGUARD')"
}

output "wireguard_server_ids" {
  value = [for s in data.unifi_vpn_servers.wireguard.vpn_servers : s.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) An optional Official-API filter expression applied server-side when listing VPN servers.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `vpn_servers` (Attributes List) The VPN servers defined on the site. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpn_servers))

<a id="nestedatt--vpn_servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpn_servers`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the VPN server is enabled.
- `id` (String) The Official API UUID of the VPN server.
- `metadata_origin` (String) The origin of the entity (`USER_DEFINED` or `DERIVED`).
- `name` (String) The name of the VPN server.
- `type` (String) The VPN server type (e.g. `WIREGUARD`, `OPENVPN`).
